Direction (1-4): Eight friends namely J, R, S, P, A, N, D and T consist of a family of three  
generations such that there are two married couples in the family. For every person of the family  
either both or none of the parents are alive. S's sister-in-law is mother of D. T is an unmarried  
female. D's mother doesn't have any siblings. J is the father-in-law of N who is the mother of two  
children. R is grandmother of D who is nephew of P.  
Solution:  
1. How many children does J. have?  
(a) One  
(b) Two  
(c) Three  
(d) Four  
(e) Five  
Ans: (c)  
2. How is A related to T?  
(a) Mother  
Blood Relation Assignment - 2  
(b) Brother  
(c) Aunt  
(d) Uncle  
(e) Father  
Ans: (e)  
3. How is S related to R?  
(a) Daughter  
(b) Son in law  
(c) Son  
(d) Husband  
(e) CND  
Ans: (e)  
4. How is N related to P?  
(a) Sister-in-law  
(b) Mother-in-law  
(c) Wife  
(d) Daughter in law  
(e) Brother-in-law  
Ans: (a)
